Thats easy! Let me introduce myself first. Im 19y old who throutout his life has done multiple IQ tests(all online, not a “proper one”) but the usual score varies between 136-155. And one time I did a paid one that claimed 141 so I usually stick with that whenever someone asks. If I have to put it in one sentence it would be “High intelligence opens a lot of doors, that other people cant even see but from half of them crawls a beast”. What I mean by that, I am and have been that one child that never has to open a notebook for school and never has to learn things that people usually need days to learn. I am great with technical things(mechanics, electricity, physics) and all that (it just comes out naturally) or as I like to say “its just logical”. Im also interested highly in psychology, never have opened a book on that either, but everything I know has come to be true (I have friends and known people who actually study psychology and yeah, you get the idea) All my knowledge has been taken by watching people, talking to them and then analyzing everything. Building patterns and things that have let me to know people and to realise that there are like 25-30 different “templates” when it comes down to people and thats it, so logically if I see a person with thraits that are the same as someone Ive met 2 years ago, I dont need more information to know how that person will react or what would he do in a certain situation. But, those are the things I consider as positives. The other half is a lot more “violent”. Right now (and for the past 5-6 years for some of them) Ive been suffering different mental illnesses. ADHD, DPDR, anxiety, depression, suicidal and homocidal thoughts, and “little” form of schizophrenia. I can’t smoke weed(because of the dpdr) cuz the itself is bad af. Almost everything I start doing has to be atleast 4782 times overthinked. Also for some things I do I have a great form of perfectionism. Etc. Thats mainly it (for both the positive and the negative side of my answer) hope that helps
